alkylation reagent: Carbamidomethyl (C) was set as a fixed modification
collision energy: The normalized collision energy (NCE) was set to 28%
enrichment method: For phosphopeptide enrichment, TiO2 beads were prepared
fractionation method: loaded into a homemade Durashell reverse-phase column
fragmentation method: each full scan followed by 20 MS2 scans (HCD)
instrument: coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: with label-free quantification (LFQ) based on MS1 intensity measurements
